Its pea flowers flavoured skin wraps semi-melted palm sugar that would burst upon the first bite. Each onde-onde is coated with fresh shredded coconut. 
What I absolutely love about onde-onde/ buah melaka is the chewiness of the ball and the sudden burst of palm sugar syrup when you bite into it.
